structured_output.what_is_happening: A token named 'company' is trading in a PumpSwap pool that is about 36 minutes old. It is not a pump.fun curve coin: there is no pump suffix and migrated_unix is 0. The price is up about 320% on the hour, with $1.9M of volume against roughly $46k of liquidity (41x turnover). At least 7 other tokens named 'company' opened pools within about 70 minutes of each other, most with similar ~$43-47k starting liquidity. Three of them already show zero liquidity after heavy volume (92iX had $644k h1 volume, now $0 liquidity), and a fourth (ForVg) is down to $15 after $357k. This looks like a template or launchpad-style serial deployment, and the linked socials (yourcompanyfun on X, stonkfunxyz on Telegram) point to a platform rather than a project. GMGN flags 100 bundler wallets holding 28% of the top-trader share. There are 2,111 unique buyers but only 108 unique sellers, and about 1,800 of those buyers arrived in the first 30 minutes. That pattern looks like bot distribution or wash activity rather than organic demand. The LP is 0% locked/burned, the creator wallet is closed, and RugCheck flags unlocked LP with only a few LP providers.
